definitions.explanation: A checkout machine where customers scan and pay for their items themselves without a cashier.

examples.japanese: セルフレジを{使|つか}おう。
セルフレジのほうが{早|はや}い。
{最近|さいきん}はセルフレジを{導入|どうにゅう}する{店|みせ}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Recently, more stores have introduced self-checkout.

notes:
セルフレジ is increasingly common in Japanese convenience stores, supermarkets, and retailers. There are two types: {完全|かんぜん}セルフレジ (fully self-service) and セミセルフレジ (staff scans, customer pays).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフレジ{導入|どうにゅう} (self-checkout introduction)
- セルフレジ{専用|せんよう} (self-checkout only)
- セルフレジの{使|つか}い{方|かた} (how to use self-checkout)

RELATED TERMS:
- {有人|ゆうじん}レジ: staffed checkout
- バーコード: barcode
- キャッシュレス: cashless payment
